descFull: Alzeo is an open-source installer that turns an NVIDIA DGX Spark, or any GB10 machine (ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, MSI, GIGABYTE, Acer), into a private AI server in one command: measured model lanes, OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, and a local cockpit.
